structured_output.summary: The bug was real. Before this change, the checked card was only scrolled into the row when a click or arrow key picked it (pick(id, true)). game.showMenu() calls select(id) and then show(), which both went through pick(id, false), and neither scrolled. So in a row that scrolls, the checked (mustard) card could end up outside the visible part of the row. Fix: one line in StartScreen.show() in src/ui/start-screen.ts. After screen.show(), it now calls `cards.find((c) => c.id === selected)?.element.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' })`. It has to run after the overlay is visible because scrolling does nothing while the overlay is hidden. With 'nearest' it does nothing when the card is already in view, and it doesn't scroll the page (the test checks scrollY stays 0). I added the verifier's repro as tests/ui/checked-card-in-row.test.ts: game build, 600×360 touch, Hay Loop finished, startRace pine-ridge then showMenu. It asserts the checked card is Pine Ridge, the row scrolls, the page hasn't scrolled, and the card sits inside the row. It failed before the fix (card right edge 724 > row right edge 564.5) and passes after. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes (158 files, 873 tests). I didn't take screenshots: this changes scroll position, not how anything looks, and the tests check it.
